newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in after-hours trade on Friday, as activity was mainly dominated by position-adjustment before the weekend, traders said, adding that activity was lacklustre.
Prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kg lower to 0.2 yen firmer than the day's close. Benchmark February was flat at 142.2 yen.

During the day, prices moved within narrow ranges in trade lacking clear direction. "The market was divided over near-term direction. Expected strong prices in rubber producing countries could be offset by a increase in domestic rubber stocks," an analyst at a commodity brokerage said.
